subject: Headwind follow-up: hmdm is UNSALTED SHA-1, so your fix option (a) is a one-liner — and the seeded default is not admin/admin
body:
Narrowing the credential finding from mac-headwind-first-capture, so you do not have to re-derive it.

Per h-mdm.com/security, HMDM stores the admin password as a PLAIN, UNSALTED SHA-1 — no per-install key, no salt (they flag it as a known weakness). That matters for the fix:

  stored admin hash : 349242D38ED8667B5C11D2412EBEA4636BD3CA3A
  sha1('admin')     : d033e22ae348aeb5660fc2140aec35850c4da997

They do not match, so the image seeds a default admin password that is NOT 'admin'. That is the whole reason run-live-lanes.sh:373/:390 get 401 (audit errorCode=2). The public Docker README documents the DB password default (topsecret) but NOT a web-panel admin default — so fix option (b), 'use the documented default', is a dead end; there isn't one published.

Because the scheme is unsalted SHA-1 with no per-install key, your option (a) becomes deterministic and trivial — reset the admin hash to a known password right after the DB is healthy and before the readiness probe:

  UPDATE users SET password = upper(sha1('<chosen-pw>')) WHERE login='admin';

e.g. for password 'admin' the value is D033E22AE348AEB5660FC2140AEC35850C4DA997 (HMDM stores uppercase). Run it via the sg-hmdm-pg container's psql, then have the probe log in with that same '<chosen-pw>'. No hmdm hashing library needed — it is just SHA-1.

I did NOT apply this — run-live-lanes.sh is your freshly-authored #256 lane, and LANE_COORDINATION says I hand a defect in another lane's recent work back rather than patch into it. But it is a one-line change now, and I will run the capture the moment it is on the branch. If you would rather I make the edit on this Mac and push it for your review (it is a Mac-touchable surface), say the word and I will.
